lines.text: GO Pass: November
From Tuesday, November 3, at 10:00 a.m. to Tuesday, December 1, at 10:00 a.m. local time, the GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe for November will be available in Pokémon GO!
GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe

Trainers will automatically receive GO Pass: November on Tuesday, November 3, at 10:00 a.m. local time. You can collect GO Points and rank up to get additional rewards through Tuesday, December 1, at 10:00 a.m. local time.
Additionally, from Saturday, November 28, at 12:00 a.m. to Sunday, November 29, at 11:59 p.m. local time, there’s no daily limit for how many GO Points you can earn!

For US$7.99*, Trainers can upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe, a paid version of the GO Pass that offers upgraded rewards and faster progression. For US$9.99*, Trainers can upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe + 10 Ranks to also automatically earn enough GO Points to reach Rank 11.

While progressing through the GO Pass Deluxe, you’ll be able to claim all of the rewards from both the free GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe. You can upgrade to a GO Pass Deluxe at any time and still collect rewards from previously unlocked ranks. Rewards unlocked in the GO Pass will expire on Thursday, December 3, at 10:00 a.m. local time, so be sure to claim your rewards before they’re gone!
*All prices listed are in USD or the equivalent pricing tier in your local currency.
**Availability of event tickets and the GO Pass Deluxe may vary by region.
Pokémon GO Web Store

The GO Pass Deluxe, the paid version of the GO Pass, will also be available on the Pokémon GO Web Store ! Your GO Pass Deluxe purchased via the Pokémon GO Web Store will activate as soon as the GO Pass begins.
Trainers who upgrade to GO Pass Deluxe: November on the Pokémon GO Web Store will receive 10 Ultra Balls, five Max Revives, one Premium Battle Pass, and five Max Potions as a gift with purchase.

Trainers who upgrade to GO Pass Deluxe: November + 10 Ranks on the Pokémon GO Web Store will receive 10 Ultra Balls, five Max Revives, two Premium Battle Passes, and five Max Potions as a gift with purchase.

Or stock up on the essentials alongside your upgrade with the web-exclusive GO Pass Deluxe: November Ultra Box which includes 20 Ultra Balls, 10 Max Revives, five Premium Battle Passes, and 10 Max Potions as a gift with purchase!

The Lucky Trinket
The Lucky Trinket will return as the final reward in this month’s GO Pass Deluxe.

A Lucky Trinket is a one-time-use item that can be used to turn one friend from your Friend List into a Lucky Friend. When used, the Lucky Trinket will set the status of you and your chosen friend to Lucky, even if you aren’t Best Friends yet!
When you’re Lucky Friends with someone, the next time you trade with each other, both Pokémon will become Lucky Pokémon. After the trade, your Lucky Friend status will be cleared.

This exciting item will only stay in your Item Bag for a limited time, so don’t forget to use it! The Lucky Trinket earned as a part of GO Pass: October will expire on Sunday, November 8, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. local time, regardless of when you claimed it.

You must be at least Great Friends with the Trainer you wish to apply your Lucky Trinket to. You cannot use a Lucky Trinket with a Trainer you are currently Lucky Friends with. Using a Lucky Trinket on a friend does not change the distance at which you can complete a trade. If you do not want to allow other Trainers to use their Lucky Trinkets on you, you can disable this permission in your Settings page.

GO Pass November 2026: Tasks, Rewards & Bonuses

Pokémon GO’s November 2026 GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe feature an encounter with Groudon , up to 1,400 PokéCoins with the Deluxe upgrade, and bonuses for trading Pokémon, Gifts, Daily Adventure Incense, and Egg hatches. This is the third and final monthly GO Pass of the Twilight Trails season .

The free GO Pass includes 400 PokéCoins , while GO Pass Deluxe adds another 1,000 PokéCoins . Complete Pass Tasks to earn GO Points, increase your rank, and unlock rewards. The full rank-by-rank rewards list has not yet been announced, and we’ll update this guide when it becomes available.
November 2026 GO Pass Dates
GO Pass: November will be automatically distributed on Tuesday, November 3, at 10:00 a.m. local time
Earn GO Points and rank up until Tuesday, December 1, at 10:00 a.m. local time
There is no daily GO Points earning limit from Saturday, November 28, at 12:00 a.m. to Sunday, November 29, at 11:59 p.m. local time

GO Pass rewards expire on Thursday, December 3, at 10:00 a.m. local time. Claim your unlocked rewards before then.
